data_fields.name: deposit_rounding
data_fields.donor_constant: taken with ceil, refunded with floor (donor); sketch uses floor for both

best_idea: Hold a reward as escrow with the arbiter at offer time, and settle it exactly once, with the check, consume, settle order, so a timeout or a claim can never pay twice or take items without paying.
decision_why: The escrow and once-only settlement are the right shape for stakes and timed quests, but the donor order (consume then settle), its rounding and its ignored refund failure must be fixed in our version.
acceptance: A player accepts a slay quest with a 1000-coin escrow; if the timeout passes the escrow returns to the NPC once; if the player claims a courier after the timeout has already settled the quest, no items are taken and the player is told the quest is closed; a server test asserts both.
